findings.affected_surface: evals/skill-onoff/ pre-registration: ordering of the §4 rules freeze relative to Phase-0 smoke (plan §8 P3 vs plan §11 Acceptance 2), plus reuse of smoke rows as matrix cells
findings.claim: The plan states opposite orderings for the rules freeze versus the first live smoke runs, so the R2 guarantee that V1/V2/V3 are frozen before the first live run is ambiguous, and the clause reusing smoke rows as matrix cells could admit pre-freeze observations into the gating dataset.
findings.evidence: Plan §8 P3 sequences 'rules freeze (§4) → Phase-0 live smoke ≤6 runs', while plan §11 Acceptance 2 demands the same smoke evidence 'before rules freeze'; plan §3 Run matrix adds 'Phase-0 smoke ≤6 live runs, reused as matrix cells via resume-by-cell'. Smoke runs are live runs by the plan's own wording, so one of the two orderings violates the frozen-before-first-live-run requirement, and under the §11 ordering reused smoke cells would be pre-freeze data.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §8 P3; PLAN §11 Acceptance criterion 2; PLAN §3 Run matrix; RUBRIC R2
findings.repair: Amend the plan to a single order: commit the §4 freeze (task set, markers.sh set, fixtures manifest digests, seeds, rules text) before any live run including Phase-0 smoke; reword Acceptance 2 to 'after rules freeze and before primary spend'; permit smoke rows to be reused as matrix cells only when executed post-freeze on the frozen artifacts; record the freeze commit SHA in the evidence dir before the first smoke run.

findings.affected_surface: Frozen §4 rules text and score-onoff.js counting for infra_fail cells that are recorded missing
findings.claim: The frozen counting rules leave threshold semantics undefined when one or two infra_fail cells exhaust the three re-run attempts and are recorded missing while staying under the arm-level invalidation trigger.
findings.evidence: Plan §4 Exclusions re-run infra_fail cells (max 3 attempts, then recorded missing) and invalidate only when more than 10% of an arm's cells end infra_fail; with 21 cells per arm, one or two missing cells proceed while thresholds stay keyed to nominal n (n=9, n=6, n=3) and V1 stays fixed at ≥ 14/21, with no rule for how a missing cell scores.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §4 Exclusions, V1, V2, V3 threshold text; RUBRIC R2
findings.repair: Add one sentence to the text frozen at P3: a recorded-missing cell counts as a failure for every family it touches and as a non-invocation toward V1's denominator of 21; no n rescaling and no re-runs beyond the three attempts, keeping the conservative reading mechanical.

findings.affected_surface: Task-prompt hygiene grep gate in evals/skill-onoff/ and its enforcing test
findings.claim: The leakage grep vocabulary is a hand-enumerated list, so marker literals can be omitted from the gate; several marker-bearing tokens are already absent from the listed vocabulary.
findings.evidence: Plan §3 gate list covers S-scope-gate, L-1.5, L-1.6, L-5, H-9, ongoing-maintenance, session-start-sha, dev-flow, quality-pipeline, finish-flow, blockedBy; but the markers include fix/* branches (d3, d7), ^hotfix/ branches (d4), and the 驗證合約 section exercised by d5, none of which the gate lists.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §3 Prompt-hygiene grep gate and task/marker table; RUBRIC R3
findings.repair: Derive the grep vocabulary mechanically at P3 from the frozen markers.sh literal set (every literal or regex source markers.sh tests) and enforce the derivation inside skill-onoff-markers.test.sh so adding a marker without its grep token turns the test red.

findings.affected_surface: profiles rule-migration map rows and the P4/P7 commit split for guided-compatibility baseline re-establishment
findings.claim: The plan does not name the commit that carries the migration map's removed and relocation disposition rows, although the only true deletion exists only once the card ships at P7.
findings.evidence: Plan §7 places disposition handling inside the P4 phase (P4 merges before P7 can) while plan §6 marks the sole CUT (S Session End 249-263) as requiring P4; plan §8 P7 defines the single swap commit as SKILL.md plus regenerated profiles artifacts plus codex mirror resync without naming rule-migration rows.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §7; PLAN §6 CUT row; PLAN §8 P4 and P7; RUBRIC R5
findings.repair: State explicitly that P4 ships the successor-baseline machinery over the pre-card universe and that the migration map's relocated and removed rows for the card disposition land inside the P7 swap commit, with the §7 red-case test and build-profile-payload.js catalog --check re-run against the post-swap state.

findings.affected_surface: docs/BACKLOG.md rows added by P0 and plan §9 surface 11
findings.claim: Two of the three deferred items that R8 requires as named BACKLOG rows, the quality-pipeline card and post-ship telemetry, have no named row-creation step.
findings.evidence: Plan §2 Decision 2 calls quality-pipeline a follow-up and §12 lists it as out of scope with no row; plan §9 surface 11 adds only the tier-A/B row and the post-ship observation row, with TaskCreate-compliance telemetry labeled documented-only as an honest gap; only the contract-density counter is explicitly tagged BACKLOG in §5 rule 4.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §2 Decision 2; PLAN §9 surface 11; PLAN §12; PLAN §5 rule 4; RUBRIC R8
findings.repair: Extend the P0 / surface-11 BACKLOG additions with a named quality-pipeline contract-card row (blocked on the validated instrument) and either a named telemetry row or explicit wording that the post-ship observation row owns telemetry as documented-only.

findings.affected_surface: references/skill-contract-card.md versus the CLAUDE.md:73 one-liner (single canonical home)
findings.claim: The new spec doc is styled as the canonical operational definition while CLAUDE.md keeps its one-liner, producing a second canonical statement of card shape unless the pointer relationship is made explicit.
findings.evidence: Plan §5 opens with 'Canonical operational definition of CLAUDE.md:73's one-liner' and cites the scaffold-tiers single-canonical-home precedent, yet no phase or ship surface edits CLAUDE.md:73 (plan §8 P1 and §9 surfaces omit it).
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §5 opening; PLAN §8 P1; PLAN §9; RUBRIC R8
findings.repair: In P1, convert CLAUDE.md:73 into a pointer to references/skill-contract-card.md (or explicitly mark the spec doc as subordinate operational detail with the one-liner remaining the single canonical statement) and add that choice as a checkbox row in the §5 review checklist.

findings.affected_surface: Live-run budget interpretation in plan §2 Decision 3 and the P6 evidence-report spend ledger
findings.claim: The plan never pins which reading of the 60-90 figure governs, and the advisory haiku block is an allowance category the rubric's enumeration omits, so total-spend auditability rests on unstated arithmetic.
findings.evidence: Plan §2 Decision 3 sets 'Budget: 60-90 live runs' with pre-registered 63 primary + 21 advisory + ≤6 smoke (sum 90) and worst case +21 iteration, while the rubric phrase is 'approved 60-90 primary budget (+bounded smoke/iteration allowances)' with no advisory category.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §2 Decision 3; PLAN §3 Run matrix; RUBRIC R8
findings.repair: Add one sentence to §2 fixing the interpretation (60-90 = total live runs including advisory and smoke per settled decision 3, with the bounded +21 iteration excess on top) and require the P6 evidence report to ledger actual spend per category against it.

findings.affected_surface: evals/skill-onoff/ pre-registration: §3 channel 2, §4 F2/V2 family counts, P3 freeze order
findings.claim: V1/V2/V3 cannot be frozen as written: Phase-0 already showed TaskCreate/task-store is unmeasurable, but the plan still freezes six families and V2 as 4-of-6, and it still sequences rules freeze before the smoke that its own acceptance criterion says must precede freeze.
findings.evidence: The 2026-08-18 Phase-0 probe on claude 2.1.234 found no TaskCreate tool in headless -p and no task JSON under the scratch home; it required dropping F2, naming TaskCreate as an unmeasured surface, and rescaling V2 after family count 6 to 5. The plan still lists task-store JSON plus blockedBy as marker channel 2, still scores F2 on d1/d2/d4 TaskCreates, and still states instrument VALID iff at least 4 of 6 families are load-bearing. P3 still says rules freeze then Phase-0 smoke; §11 criterion 2 says smoke before freeze. Remaining F3 cells (d3 merge to develop, d4 hotfix from main --no-ff to main) also assume named main/develop branches, but the reused orchestration temp-repo init only creates one frozen-base commit on the default branch.
findings.evidence_reference: docs/plans/evidence/2026-08-18-dev-flow-contract-card/phase0-probe.md:23-39; plan §3 marker channels and F2 rows; plan §4 V2 4-of-6; plan §8 P3; plan §11 item 2; evals/orchestration/run-orchestration-eval.sh:93-103
findings.repair: Before any P3-freeze or P5 cell: drop F2 from the live family set and name TaskCreate/task-store as an unmeasured gap beside multi-turn and Mission Routing Override; freeze a revised V2 threshold on the remaining families; pin d3/d4 fixture git topology so main and develop exist before the agent starts; rewrite P3 so freeze happens only after the already-run probe (and any leftover smoke) is folded; do not spend another live run to rediscover tool-absence.

findings.affected_surface: evals/skill-onoff/ synthetic plugin assembly and scratch CLI env
findings.claim: The three arms do not isolate only dev-flow presence/content: CARD relocated prose is not guaranteed to be on disk in the plugin, and the runner does not pin CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR to scratch, so the operator's installed plugin can leak into OFF.
findings.evidence: The arm table varies only skills/dev-flow/SKILL.md and copies companion SKILL.md files. §6 MOVE relocates the L-Full Reference checklist and Context Health Check into skills/dev-flow/references/session-end.md and more prose into historical-rationale.md. The successful Phase-0 plugin copied only SKILL.md. If CARD's references tree is absent, CARD is content-ablated rather than a relocated card, which is a second variable and a straw-man risk. The runner text sets scratch HOME and says never point CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR at the real ~/.claude, but does not export CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR to the scratch tree; the working probe did. An unset CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR can load the installed autopilot plugin and put real dev-flow into OFF.
findings.evidence_reference: plan §3 Arms table and runner flags; plan §6 MOVE bullets; docs/plans/evidence/2026-08-18-dev-flow-contract-card/phase0-probe.md:7-12
findings.repair: Specify that FULL and CARD copy the whole skills/dev-flow tree (SKILL.md plus the matching references/ tree, digest-pinned); companions copy their full trees identically across arms; OFF omits only skills/dev-flow/. Export both HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR to the scratch tree, matching the Phase-0 probe. Add spend-free assertions: roster/references parity, no hooks, no extra plugins, description-byte-equality.

findings.affected_surface: P7 swap-commit rollback versus P8 --update-baseline after P1 per-skill check 8
findings.claim: P7 is not actually single-commit revert-safe once P1 adds a per-skill line-budget map and P8 runs --update-baseline after the card swap.
findings.evidence: Today docs/metrics/surface-lines.json has only version, prose=13800, and engine. P1 extends preflight check 8 with a skills map and a do-not-grow ratchet. P7 swaps SKILL.md plus regenerated profiles and the codex mirror. P8 then runs --update-baseline. After a card ship that update would record the ~440-470 line card as the cap. Reverting only the P7 commit restores the 713-line file against that lowered cap, so check 8 fails. The P7 revert ritual names profiles regen and mirror resync but not the per-skill baseline.
findings.evidence_reference: plan §8 P7-P8; plan §5 rule 4 and check-8 extension; plan §10 Rollback row; docs/metrics/surface-lines.json; scripts/preflight-release.sh:31-46 and check 8
findings.repair: Fold the per-skill surface-lines update into the P7 swap commit (or document that rollback reverts the P7+P8 pair). Keep P8 to preflight-release, INDEX, and archive. Do not let a post-swap --update-baseline be the only copy of the new per-skill cap.
